title: Comparative study of machine learning and statistical survival models for enhancing cervical cancer prognosis and risk factor assessment using SEER data
summary: The study evaluates survival prediction and risk factors for cervical cancer in SEER using machine-learning and statistical survival models. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: The study evaluates survival prediction and risk factors for cervical cancer in SEER using machine-learning and statistical survival models.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: US SEER records for 3,810 patients diagnosed in 2013–2015 are modeled with held-out validation and comparative survival metrics.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
